configuration: omi2026: wearable capture with an enrolled speech profile, a retained personal backend, authorized agentic chat tools and a proactive-notification app; rollout-gated desktop JIT features excluded. Judged at commit 5a46ab0 as the default server path: /v4/listen capture with include_speech_profile (default true) and stored person profiles; conversation finalization in process_conversation (notes with related open tasks, canonical memory extraction, Pinecone vector); agentic chat with the non-JIT core tools (conversations, memories, action items, Google Calendar, Gmail, Apple Health, fetch_url, Perplexity, save_user_preference, manage_daily_summary) plus device tools that the client declares; proactive notifications from the built-in mentor (MENTOR_PIPELINE default 'legacy') and from third-party proactive_notification apps.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Captured audio is transcribed. After the silence timeout the conversation is saved and processed: an LLM extracts title, overview, action items and events, extracts memories that link back to the source conversation, and the conversation is embedded into Pinecone. Enrolling the owner's voice or naming another speaker writes a voice profile or person record. Each human chat turn is stored before the agent runs.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: The mentor decides whether to notify and what to say from retained data: user facts, goals, past conversations from vector and recency search, and its own earlier notifications. A third-party proactive app's template is filled with stored facts, retrieved conversation context and recent app chat. The agentic chat answers from memories, conversations and tasks it retrieves itself, plus the last chat messages.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: In the agentic chat the action-selecting LLM chooses which tools to call and with what parameters, and keeps calling them when it needs more context. Integration tools then acquire current external observations: live Google Calendar and Gmail API queries on the user's authorized integrations (agent-chosen start_date/end_date/search_query), Perplexity web search, URL fetch, and on-device contact search. Action's information needs set the acquisition targets. The device tool propose_message also sets an expected-effect check: its sent/cancelled result is read before the agent reports.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: The service keeps its own delivered outputs for later use. Each chat answer is persisted, with langsmith_run_id and prompt_commit, and reread as context. Each mentor or app notification is stored in the app chat and reread by the next mentor evaluation as RECENT NOTIFICATIONS, so the mentor avoids repeating itself.

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Users can rate AI chat messages, including app/mentor thread messages, thumbs up or down with an optional reason code and comment. The rating is stored on the message, in a rating-score record, and in a feedback ledger keyed to the message's langsmith_run_id and prompt_commit. Users can also approve or reject extracted memories (user_review), and device tools return the user's send-or-cancel result.

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: There are two kinds of evidence. Immediate checks: the agent must read the result of its own tool action before reporting it. The propose_message result (status=sent or cancelled) decides whether the agent may say a message was sent and stops retries. A memory write may be claimed only on a confirming tool result, which the loop also parses. Retained correction: memories the owner rejected are put into later extraction prompts as negative examples, so the same memory is not extracted again. Chat ratings are linked to message, run and prompt, but they only reach an admin daily thumbs-down report and LangSmith; that is offline developer review and is not counted.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: In this configuration every durable write the service makes is content read by fixed prompts and matchers: memories, agent-learned preferences, tasks, chat and notification history, speaker embeddings, goal progress, and rejected-memory examples. The protocol treats preferences and facts as content, not revisions. Settings changes made through chat tools are user-requested. The agent-authored reusable playbooks (save_playbook) and standing triggers are JIT-only tools withheld outside the JIT rollout, so they are excluded. The agent system prompt comes from a developer-managed LangSmith prompt. The proactivity v2 producer-kill latch is rollout-gated and off by default.
revision.quote: # JIT-only tools: schemas must not reach the model for users outside the JIT
revision.what: Nothing is revised in this configuration; only content changes (memories, preferences, tasks, speaker embeddings, chat/notification history). The JIT-only save_playbook (reusable agent-written workflows) and the gated proactivity-v2 kill latch are excluded.
